subject: Advance commitment illustration & budgetary quote for FY28
messages:
From: Elaine Khan <elaine.khan@stratohealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@stratohealth.com
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Budget request: FY28 annual advance commitment options

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — we're kicking off FY28 planning and need a budgetary quote for an annual advance commitment. High level: StratoHealth is planning LLM usage for clinical summarization across 3 product lines. We're targeting a starting usage of ~250M tokens/month in Year 1, with expected growth. Procurement has asked for: 

- A 1-year annual prepay option with unit pricing and discount tiers;
- A 3-year advance commitment option (with suggested ramp schedule and year-by-year pricing);
- Standard pro forma invoice showing payment timing (annual vs. quarterly billing on prepay) and tax handling for a US entity;
- Any assumptions you used (QPS, sequence-length, KV cache expectations) so our finance team can justify the number.

Attached is our short RFQ and the usage snapshot. Can you get a high-level pro forma and at least two named options so I can share with finance this week? We're aiming to surface this in our exec budget meeting on 2026-12-08.

Best,
Elaine
Elaine Khan
Head of Procurement, StratoHealth
Attachments: RFQ_StratoHealth_Request_20261129.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Khan <elaine.khan@stratohealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Budget request: FY28 annual advance commitment options

Hi Elaine — thanks for the RFQ and the timeline. Quick response below and I attached a short worksheet with two starter scenarios: a 1-year annual advance and a 3-year ramped commit.

Summary (very high level):
- Option A (1-year annual advance): 15% term discount off list for a single-year annual prepay at your stated baseline (250M tokens/mo). Invoiced up front, refundable only per our standard terms.
- Option B (3-year advance with ramp): blended term discounts that increase with term and commit size: Year 1 = 20% off list, Year 2 = 25% off list, Year 3 = 30% off list (illustrative; we can lock exact percentages with commit thresholds). Billing can be annual upfront or split into quarterly invoices against the prepay balance.

Assumptions used in worksheet: average seq len 768 tokens, 70/30 chat-to-completion ratio, KV cache enabled for 40% of recurrent prefixes (saves ~8-12% tokens). If your actual distribution skews longer, numbers shift.

Next steps: can you confirm whether StratoHealth prefers annual upfront invoicing or quarterly invoicing against the prepay? Also, if you can share the target ramp profile (how you expect volume to move across FY28-30), we'll produce a formal pro forma PDF and a sample invoice schedule.

I've looped in Vanessa (sales lead) and Marcus (finance ops) to help finalize the pro forma and tax notes.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_FY28_Options_worksheet.xlsx

Jonas — thanks, worksheet looks helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement and finance: 

- We prefer annual invoicing up front if possible; however, we may ask for an annual invoice split into four installments for internal cashflow smoothing (i.e., invoice is issued annually but paid in quarterly installments). Is that supported?
- For the 3-year option, we expect an operational ramp roughly: 40% of steady-state in Year 1, 75% in Year 2, and 100% in Year 3 (that's our best estimate).
- Please include any standard SLA credits for downtime > SLO and any refund/credit terms if we exceed commit.

Also attaching our internal usage breakdown (sequence lengths and percent chat vs. batch) which should help you refine the pro forma.

Regards,
Elaine
Attachments: Strato_usage_snapshot_20261130.xlsx, RFQ_StratoHealth_Request_20261129.pdf
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Khan <elaine.khan@stratohealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-04T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Budget request: FY28 annual advance commitment options

Hi Elaine — Vanessa here (Sales Lead). Thanks for the ramp details — we've prepared a formal pro forma and a sample ramp invoice schedule based on the profile you shared. Key points in the attached pro forma: 

- Option 1 (Annual Advance, 1-year): 17% off list at 250M tokens/mo baseline; invoice issued up front for the year. Includes 30-day payment terms and standard non-refundable clause.
- Option 2 (3-year Advance, ramped): year-by-year effective discounts applied to committed token buckets: Y1 effective discount 22%, Y2 27%, Y3 32% (examples tied to commit thresholds). We built the schedule for the ramp you provided (40/75/100).
- Billing: we can issue a single annual invoice for each year of the 3-year commit, or issue one master invoice for the full 3-year amount and allow StratoHealth to pay each annual tranche on agreed due dates. We are flexible to support an annual invoice that is paid via quarterly installments — we'll add a payment schedule appendix to the pro forma if you choose that route.
- SLA credits: standard SLO credit schedule included; exceptions and legal redlines can be discussed with your legal team.

Attached: Redwood_ProForma_FY28_OptionB.pdf (pro forma with tables), Redwood_FY28_Options_worksheet.xlsx (updated). I also added a short note on tax handling for US entities (sales tax/VAT not expected for Redwood-hosted services in most US states; will confirm with finance if StratoHealth has nexus in specific states).

If this looks aligned, I can convert Option 2 into a draft contract and send a DocuSign envelope for PO signature or create an invoice-only pro forma if you prefer to attach a PO. HubSpot deal updated here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/STR-2026-0921

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_ProForma_FY28_OptionB.pdf, Redwood_FY28_Options_worksheet.xlsx
